summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the rdflib SPARQL plugin. Changes: Update class added to rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py returns an Update on every path (empty request translates q.prologue[0]); evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to processor.py and exported from plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepare.py added. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests are unverified. Also: pprintAlgebra now prints the algebra list as a single object for update containers (debug output only in test_dawg). Black formatting was not checked by running the tool. No commits made.
